Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 51447 of 2023
Applicant :- Dijendra

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Anand Prakash Dubey,Ashima Goel,Manu Srivastava,Pradeep Kumar B
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Sudhanshu Jaiswal,Sunny Srivastava,Vivek Kumar Srivas
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Sri Manu Srivastava, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Vivek Kumar Srivastava, learned
counsel for the informant and Sri Santosh Nigam, learned Aga for the State-respondent.
2.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
276 of 2023, under Sections 376, 313, 506, 354 Ipc and 67 I.T. Act, Police Station- Kithaur, District-
Meerut, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

sentences.text:
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that on the basis of false allegation, applicant has
been made accused in the present matter and he never committed rape upon the victim.

4. He further submitted that however, victim during investigation supported the prosecution case
but when she appeared before the trial court concerned then she did not support the prosecution
case and has been declared hostile and her statement recorded before the trial court has been
annexed along with supplementary affidavit dated 16.06.2024.

sentences.text:
He further submitted that applicant is not having any criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since 16.09.2023 i.e. for last more than a year.
6.

Per contra, learned AGA however, opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact that during trial victim of the case has turned hostile and applicant is in jail in the present matter for last more than a years.
7. Learned counsel for the informant also conceded that during trial victim of the case did not support the prosecution case and has been declared hostile.
He next submits, even informant is having no objection if applicant be enlarged on bail.
8. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.
9. However, there is allegation of rape against the applicant but it reflects that victim of the case during trial did not support the prosecution case and has been declared hostile.

10. Further, applicant is not having any criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since 16.09.2023 i.e. for last more than a year.
11.
Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
12. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

13. Let the applicant- Dijendra be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
14. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

15. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
